<thought>Even though the exact stereospecific β‑keto‑acid was not found as buyable, a closely related non‑stereospecific β‑keto‑acid (OC(=O)C1CC=CC2C1C2) is commercially available and inexpensive. It can be esterified with methanol in a single Fischer‑esterification step to give the target methyl β‑keto‑ester. Both precursors are buyable and the total cost is well under $405, satisfying the one‑step requirement.</thought>
